chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The cost of the shroud is from the entirety of the estate.

key_terms.جَمِيعِ: the whole or entirety of something
key_terms.ٱلْكَفَنِ: the burial shroud used for the deceased

ai.seo_question: Is the cost of the kafan taken from the whole estate of the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning funeral expenses after death. It establishes that the price of the kafan is to be taken from the deceased’s total estate.
